verdict.rationale: A managed database service could plausibly publish a policy or control against using customer data for AI training, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training on customer data. BYOC data residency and private networking are related privacy controls, but neither is a training opt-out or a no-training commitment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
